title: Modalities
description: The buyer's request to the seller: consume-onsite, pickup, delivery, or virtual — the committed declaration of which coordination scenario the process runs. Single-select — an assembly composes exactly one modality; a seller offers variety by holding an array of assemblies, one per configuration. The transfers themselves are recorded by process clauses (attestations article) as timeline events. Coordination variants (how a courier edge is arranged) are separate assemblies; Hand-off (where a physical exchange happens) is its own composable clause, with proximity verification nesting under it.

fields.name: modality
fields.description: The buyer's request. consume-onsite = consumed at the seller's premises. pickup = the buyer collects. delivery = a courier order carries it to the buyer (composed as a second, co-equal buyer↔courier order). virtual = digital, no physical hand-off.
